title: Describe a due date
prompt: Write public static string DueText(int? days). days is the number of days until a task is due. It is either null or 0 and above. Return "no due date" for null, "due today" for 0, "due tomorrow" for 1, and "due in 5 days" (with the number) for anything larger.
hints: Which input means there is no date at all, and which means the date is today?
Test for null before you compare the number.
Return early for null, then for 0, then for 1, and build the last text with the number.
checkLabels: A missing number must give "no due date".

wrongAnswers.misconception: Treats 0 days as if no date was set.
Turns a missing date into 0, so it reads as due today.

feedback: Compare the results for null and for 0. They must be different texts, so the null test has to come before any fallback to a number.
